meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browse the web for any task — research topics, read articles, interact with web apps, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and test web pages. Use whenever a browser would be useful, not just when the user explicitly asks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用浏览器自动完成网页浏览、数据提取和测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器完成各种网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate web browsing, data extraction, and testing with a browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control a browser for web tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以自动打开网页、点击按钮、填写表单、截图、提取文字和链接、保存 PDF，还能登录网站并记住登录状态。
howto.when: 当你需要 Claude 帮你查资料、填表单、测试网页或从网站提取信息时，它会自动使用浏览器。

say.text: 帮我打开百度，搜索今天的新闻。
say.note: Claude 会打开百度并搜索。

say.text: 登录我的邮箱，把收件箱截图发给我。
say.note: Claude 会打开邮箱登录页，你需要提供账号密码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can open web pages, click buttons, fill forms, take screenshots, extract text and links, save PDFs, and log into websites while remembering login state.
howto.when_en: When you need Claude to research, fill forms, test web pages, or extract data from websites, it will automatically use the browser.

say_en.text: Open Google and search for today's news.
say_en.note: Claude will open Google and perform the search.

say_en.text: Log into my email and screenshot the inbox.
say_en.note: Claude will open the email login page; you need to provide credentials.
